text_to_image_prompt: Create one standalone photorealistic female character portrait. Long straight medium brown hair parted near the center and tucked behind an ear, fair skin, green-hazel eyes, straight brown brows, delicate oval face, pink lips. Dark gray sleeveless V-neck school sweater with white trim, white shirt, burgundy striped tie. Slight three-quarter turn, direct gaze. Single person on a seamless pure white background, vertical composition with the entire head visible and breathing space above the hair. Bright soft frontal studio daylight, low-contrast natural shadows, natural detailed skin and individual hair strands, restrained makeup, subtle halation, realistic 50mm perspective, coherent cream-white and warm-brown color grading. Upper-body portrait; retain visible clothing texture and natural folds. No text, watermark, logo, collage, border, other people, scenery, plastic skin, illustration or CGI rendering.

original_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate ONE new fictional female character portrait, a single person in a single standalone vertical image, not a grid, contact sheet or multiple views. Input image 1 is the corresponding source reference: take broad hair, face type, clothing and expression inspiration, but invent a distinct original identity, never reuse photo pixels. Input image 2 is ONLY the approved lighting, photographic texture and white-background style authority; do not copy its person, freckles or wardrobe. Prioritize image 2's bright clean live-action realism over image 1's grading. Pure solid white #FFFFFF seamless empty background, no gradient, furniture, scenery, shadows on backdrop, vignette, border, logos, lettering or watermark. Soft broad frontal light, high-key neutral-warm exposure, low shadow density, subtle halation, natural skin pores and realistic fine hair, 50mm portrait perspective. Cream, pale grey and warm brown tonal harmony with outfit-specific accents. No illustration, CGI, plastic skin, dark teal grade, heavy makeup, tan cinematic filter or excessive HDR. Portrait framing mid-torso upward with complete head and hair top, comfortable white margin, both shoulders readable, natural anatomy. Generally late-teen/young-adult appearance like corresponding reference; do not invent older ages or switch ethnicity from reference. Fully clothed, nonsexual casting portrait. No separate labels in image. Corresponding character direction: Sleek center-parted long brown hair tucked behind ears, natural strong eyebrows, charcoal school vest with white piping, crisp white collar and burgundy tie; slight three-quarter face.
